rentListing.matchedBy: Hipflat exact project page links to this unit; direct unit page names The Next Ladprao

yieldEstimate.calculation: ((monthly rent estimate × 11 months) − annual common fee) / lowest 2BR purchase total
yieldEstimate.rentRateSource: 1BR rent sample scaled to the 2BR sale listing's 66 sqm area because no 2BR rental is shown

notes: Hipflat project page links to the direct rental unit page. The unit page identifies The Next Ladprao, 1 bedroom, 46 sqm, floor 3, ฿12,000/month, listed 2026-02-12 and updated one hour before the 2026-10-18 check.

The default investment estimate uses the lowest linked 2-bedroom PropertyHub sale listing at ฿3,699,000 for 66 sqm. The direct sale detail independently confirms 2 bedrooms, 66 sqm, and the same total.

No 2-bedroom rental is published on the checked Hipflat project page. The app therefore labels the ROI rent as a 1-bedroom per-sqm rate scaled to the 2-bedroom sale unit's area. Defaults deduct one agent month and the PropertyHub-published indicative common fee of ฿30/sqm/month.
